title: Business is private.
narration: Invoices, payroll, and supplier relationships. Business details should stay with the people who need them.

title: Fast money.
narration: Moving money is only half the job. Finance teams still need a clear paper trail.

title: Private payments.
narration: Meet Money Station. Private business payments, with evidence you choose to share.

title: Start with an invoice.
narration: Create a signed payment request. Share one link with your customer or business partner.

title: Connect. Keep control.
scope: Actual wallet selector · No payment signed
narration: Connect a supported wallet. Your signing keys stay with your wallet provider.

title: Choose your private note.
narration: Open an encrypted note from its original payment group. Its secrets stay on your device.

title: Prove it. Privately.
scope: Actual local proof · Sample chain context
narration: Generate the proof locally. Authorize the payout without revealing the input note.

title: Review. Then approve.
narration: Check the recipient, full principal, and added fee. Approve each required wallet call.

title: Follow the confirmation.
narration: Track the original payment through confirmation. An uncertain response never triggers an automatic second payment.

title: Share only what’s needed.
narration: Choose the amount, asset, or invoice reference to disclose. Keep unrelated business information private.

title: Ready for finance.
narration: Prepare a cited tax procedure draft, then request independent review. Keep preparation separate from approval.

title: Business money.
narration: Money Station. Private payments. Clear proof. Your business stays yours.
